value.rationale: The all-site nonGaussianity assertion is proved uniformly for finite N despite extra Gaussian thermal baths, unlike the existing parameter-specific numerical kurtosis evidence. More broadly, the exact iff projection criterion determines all observable Gaussianity blind spots in a stable linear network. An explicitly covariance-identical OU replacement produces the same complete two-time data but systematically strictly smaller higher even moments, giving a concrete and natural nonidentifiability obstruction for experiments and finite network model reduction. This is a structural classification with necessary and sufficient conditions, not a single-table evaluation.
